INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Digital Citizenship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Citizenship.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Digital Citizenship.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Citizenship.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Citizenship.

2. When learning Desktop Publishing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Desktop Publishing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Desktop Publishing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Desktop Publishing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Desktop Publishing.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

4. When learning Operating systems 1.4 Digital Citizenship 2.0 Productivity Tools 2.1 Word Proces, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating systems 1.4 Digital Citizenship 2.0 Productivity Tools 2.1 Word Proces.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Operating systems 1.4 Digital Citizenship 2.0 Productivity Tools 2.1 Word Proces.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Operating systems 1.4 Digital Citizenship 2.0 Productivity Tools 2.1 Word Proces.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Operating systems 1.4 Digital Citizenship 2.0 Productivity Tools 2.1 Word Proces.

5. When learning Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec.

6. When learning Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita.

7. When learning Introduction to ICT, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to ICT.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to ICT.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to ICT.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to ICT.

8. When learning Application Areas of ICT, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Application Areas of ICT.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Application Areas of ICT.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Application Areas of ICT.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Application Areas of ICT.

9. When learning The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE.
   C. Skip safety briefings for The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE.

10. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Keyboard

11. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

12. When learning Presentation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Presentation.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Presentation.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Presentation.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Presentation.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The Internet and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to ICT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Citizenship.

2. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Desktop Publishing.

3. A — Never touch live wires with wet hands

4. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating systems 1.4 Digital Citizenship 2.0 Productivity Tools 2.1 Word Proces.

5. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec.

6. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita.

7. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to ICT.

8. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Application Areas of ICT.

9. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE.

10. B — CPU

11. B — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

12. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Presentation.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Internet; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Introduction to ICT; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
